segments.text: Hello friends, welcome to your channel HSC StudyGuide

segments.text: In this video, we are going to talk about Portable Generator
segments.zh: 这期视频我们要讲的是便携式发电机，

segments.text: We are going to see what we have to face in this Portable Generator
segments.zh: 我们来看看使用便携式发电机会面临哪些危害，

segments.text: and what precautions we have to take for that
segments.zh: 以及为此需要采取哪些预防措施。

segments.text: So, let's start
segments.zh: 那我们开始吧。

segments.text: First of all, let's talk about Portable Generator
segments.zh: 首先，我们来讲讲便携式发电机。

segments.text: In Portable Generator, there is an internal combustion engine
segments.zh: 便携式发电机里有一台内燃机，

segments.text: which is used to generate electricity
segments.zh: 用来发电。

segments.text: The use of Portable Generator, especially where there is a temporary or remote electrical power supply
segments.zh: 便携式发电机主要用在需要临时供电或者偏远地区供电的地方，

segments.text: is used there
segments.zh: 就在这些地方使用，

segments.text: but it is also very hazardous
segments.zh: 但它的危险性也很大。

segments.text: So, let's know which hazardous energy can be used in Portable Generator
segments.zh: 那我们来了解一下，便携式发电机会带来哪些危险能量。

segments.text: So, the first hazardous energy is Electric Shock and Electrocution
segments.zh: 第一种危险能量是电击和触电致死，

segments.text: which can be used to use power improperly
segments.zh: 这可能是由于用电不当造成的，

segments.text: or the other electrical system can be used to create a hazard
segments.zh: 或者其他电气系统也可能造成危害。

segments.text: Then there is a hazard, Carbon Monoxide, which comes out of the generator's exhaust
segments.zh: 然后还有一种危害是一氧化碳，它来自发电机的排气。

segments.text: Then there is a hazard, Fire, i.e. fire extinguishing
segments.zh: 然后还有一种危害是火灾，也就是着火，

segments.text: and this hazard, whenever you do not refuel properly in this generator,
segments.zh: 这种危害是在你没有正确地给发电机加油的时候，

segments.text: then chances of fires increase
segments.zh: 火灾的可能性就会增加。

segments.text: Also, the fuel in the generator, if we do not store it properly,
segments.zh: 另外，发电机的燃料如果我们没有妥善储存，

segments.text: then chances of fires increase
segments.zh: 火灾的可能性也会增加。

segments.text: Then there is a hazard, Noise and Vibration
segments.zh: 然后还有一种危害是噪声和振动。

segments.text: So, all these hazards are involved in Portable Generator
segments.zh: 所以便携式发电机涉及所有这些危害。

segments.text: So, let's know what precautions we should take for this
segments.zh: 那我们来了解一下，为此应该采取哪些预防措施。

segments.text: So, the first point is Electric Shock and Electrocution
segments.zh: 第一点是电击和触电致死，

segments.text: i.e. to avoid this hazard, let's see what precautions we should take
segments.zh: 也就是为了避免这种危害，我们来看看应该采取哪些预防措施。

segments.text: So, the first point is
segments.zh: 第一点是，

segments.text: that you do not have to attach the generator directly
segments.zh: 不要把发电机直接接到

segments.text: to any electrical system of the structure
segments.zh: 建筑物的任何电气系统上，

segments.text: and for how long you do not have to install the qualified electrician
segments.zh: 除非由合格的电工

segments.text: to the generator properly and do not use a transverse switch
segments.zh: 正确地给发电机安装转换开关，否则不要这样做。

segments.text: Then, the point is that you have to plug the electrical appliances directly to the generator
segments.zh: 然后，要把电器直接插到发电机上，

segments.text: and for that, you have to use any manufacturer's supply cords or extension cords
segments.zh: 为此要使用制造商提供的电源线或延长线。

segments.text: Before using the cord, you have to inspect it well
segments.zh: 使用电线之前要好好检查，

segments.text: and you have to see whether it is damaged or not
segments.zh: 看看它有没有损坏。

segments.text: After that, you do not have to use any damaged extension cords
segments.zh: 之后，不要使用任何损坏的延长线。

segments.text: After that, you have to ensure that the cords are properly rated
segments.zh: 之后，要确保电线的额定值合适，

segments.text: i.e. how much is the WAD or how much is the ampere
segments.zh: 也就是瓦数是多少、安培数是多少，

segments.text: which we are going to use, it should be written in it
segments.zh: 我们要用的这些都应该标在上面。

segments.text: After that, if the cords are under rated
segments.zh: 之后，如果电线的额定值不足，

segments.text: i.e. if there is no rated capacity on it
segments.zh: 也就是上面没有标额定容量，

segments.text: then you do not have to use such cords
segments.zh: 那就不要使用这样的电线，

segments.text: i.e. you have to replace it
segments.zh: 也就是要把它换掉，

segments.text: and get such cords that have rated capacity on it
segments.zh: 换成上面标有额定容量的电线。

segments.text: After that, you do not have to overload the generator
segments.zh: 之后，不要让发电机过载，

segments.text: because by doing this, the generator will overheat
segments.zh: 因为这样做会让发电机过热，

segments.text: and because of that, the fire hazard can be created
segments.zh: 因此可能造成火灾危害。

segments.text: After that, the point is that you have to use GFCI
segments.zh: 之后，要使用 GFCI，

segments.text: i.e. you have to use ground fault circuit interrupters
segments.zh: 也就是要使用接地故障断路器。

segments.text: After that, you have to see that the generator is properly grounded
segments.zh: 之后，要检查发电机是否正确接地，

segments.text: and the grounding connection is properly tight
segments.zh: 接地连接是否拧紧，

segments.text: and for proper grounding methods
segments.zh: 至于正确的接地方法，

segments.text: you have to consult any manufacturer
segments.zh: 要向制造商咨询。

segments.text: After that, you have to keep the generator in the dry place
segments.zh: 之后，要把发电机放在干燥的地方，

segments.text: i.e. you do not have to use the generator in rainy or wet conditions
segments.zh: 也就是不要在下雨或潮湿的条件下使用发电机。

segments.text: If you need to use the generator, then you have to apply Canopy on the generator
segments.zh: 如果需要使用发电机，就要在发电机上加装顶棚。

segments.text: After that, if you are in wet condition or in standing condition
segments.zh: 之后，如果你处在潮湿的环境中或站在积水里，

segments.text: then in that condition, you do not have to manipulate the electrical component system of the generator
segments.zh: 那么在这种情况下，不要操作发电机的电气部件系统。

segments.text: After that, the point is that if the electrical equipment is submerged in water
segments.zh: 之后，如果电气设备被水淹没过，

segments.text: then you do not have to use that electrical equipment
segments.zh: 就不要使用那台电气设备，

segments.text: i.e. the equipment should be completely dry
segments.zh: 也就是设备应该完全干燥，

segments.text: and should be properly evaluated before using it
segments.zh: 并且在使用前要经过适当的评估。

segments.text: So in this way, we can control the electric shock and electrician hazard
segments.zh: 这样我们就能控制电击和触电危害。

segments.text: After that, what we saw in the hazard was carbon monoxide poisoning
segments.zh: 之后，我们看到的危害是一氧化碳中毒，

segments.text: So now let's know how we can control this hazard
segments.zh: 那现在我们来了解一下怎样控制这种危害。

segments.text: The first point is that you do not have to use the indoor or enclosed spaces
segments.zh: 第一点是，不要在室内或封闭空间使用，

segments.text: i.e. you do not have to use garages, crowd spaces or basements
segments.zh: 也就是不要在车库、狭小空间或地下室使用。

segments.text: After that, you have to make sure that the sides of the generator
segments.zh: 之后，要确保发电机的四周，

segments.text: i.e. the sides of the generator should be cleared up to 3-4 feet from there
segments.zh: 也就是发电机周围要留出 3-4 英尺的空地，

segments.text: and on top of the generator, you have to ensure that there is proper ventilation
segments.zh: 而且发电机上方要确保有良好的通风。

segments.text: Then the point is that you do not have to use the generator outdoors
segments.zh: 然后，不要在室外这样使用发电机，

segments.text: If you do it near the door or the window or any vents
segments.zh: 如果你在门、窗或任何通风口附近使用的话，

segments.text: because by doing this, the carbon monoxide will enter there
segments.zh: 因为这样一氧化碳会进入里面，

segments.text: and after building up in that area, the space there will be occupied
segments.zh: 在那个区域积聚之后，会充满那里的空间。

segments.text: Then the point is that if you or any other person
segments.zh: 然后，如果你或其他任何人

segments.text: because of the symptoms of carbon monoxide poisoning
segments.zh: 因为一氧化碳中毒出现症状，

segments.text: such as dizziness, headache, omitting or tightness
segments.zh: 比如头晕、头痛、呕吐或胸闷，

segments.text: if you see such symptoms, then you have to go to the fresh air immediately
segments.zh: 如果看到这些症状，就要立即到空气新鲜的地方，

segments.text: and see where medical attention can be found
segments.zh: 并看看哪里可以得到医疗救助，

segments.text: and in that area, you do not have to re-enter
segments.zh: 而且不要再进入那个区域，

segments.text: until a trained person does not determine that he is safe
segments.zh: 直到受过培训的人确认那里安全为止。

segments.text: So you have to keep in mind all these points
segments.zh: 所以这些要点都要记住，

segments.text: because of this, we can save the risk of carbon monoxide
segments.zh: 因为这样我们就能避免一氧化碳的风险。

segments.text: Then we saw the hazard, it was the fire hazard
segments.zh: 然后我们看到的危害是火灾危害，

segments.text: So let's know how we can save it
segments.zh: 那我们来了解一下怎样防范它。

segments.text: So you have to keep in mind that whenever the generator is in running condition
segments.zh: 要记住，发电机在运行的时候

segments.text: then it gets hot
segments.zh: 会变得很烫，

segments.text: and even after stopping, it stays hot for a long time
segments.zh: 而且停机之后也会长时间保持高温，

segments.text: and the fuels of the generator, whether it is gasoline or kerosene
segments.zh: 而发电机的燃料，不管是汽油还是煤油，

segments.text: if the hot engine parts are spilled on it
segments.zh: 如果洒到高温的发动机部件上，

segments.text: then it can be ignited
segments.zh: 就可能被引燃，

segments.text: that is, it can also be lit
segments.zh: 也就是会着起火来。

segments.text: So you have to keep in mind that whenever you have to refuel in the generator
segments.zh: 所以要记住，每当你要给发电机加油的时候，

segments.text: before refueling, you have to shut down that generator
segments.zh: 加油之前要先把发电机关掉，

segments.text: and after shutting down, you have to let that generator cool down
segments.zh: 关掉之后要让发电机冷却下来。

segments.text: Then the point is that the gasoline or other generator's fuels
segments.zh: 然后，汽油或发电机的其他燃料，

segments.text: like kerosene, you have to store it properly
segments.zh: 比如煤油，要妥善储存，

segments.text: and transport it properly
segments.zh: 并且要妥善运输，

segments.text: and that too in the uprooted containers
segments.zh: 而且要用合格认可的容器，

segments.text: which should be properly designed
segments.zh: 容器应该经过正确的设计，

segments.text: and there should be a mark on it
segments.zh: 上面还要有标记，

segments.text: which content is inside it
segments.zh: 注明里面装的是什么。

segments.text: Then the point is that the fuel containers
segments.zh: 然后，燃料容器

segments.text: you have to keep away from the flame producing or heat generating devices
segments.zh: 要远离产生火焰或产生热量的设备，

segments.text: For example, you have to keep away from the generator
segments.zh: 比如要远离发电机，

segments.text: keep away from the heaters of the water
segments.zh: 远离热水器，

segments.text: keep away from the cigarette
segments.zh: 远离香烟，

segments.text: keep away from the lighter
segments.zh: 远离打火机，

segments.text: and keep away from the matches
segments.zh: 还要远离火柴。

segments.text: Then the point is that where there are fuel containers
segments.zh: 然后，有燃料容器的地方

segments.text: you don't have to smoke it
segments.zh: 不要吸烟。

segments.text: Then the point is that the generator's fuels
segments.zh: 然后，发电机的燃料

segments.text: you don't have to store it in the house
segments.zh: 不要存放在屋里，

segments.text: meaning you have to store the fuels very far away from the living area
segments.zh: 也就是燃料要存放在远离生活区的地方。

segments.text: So all these points you have to keep in mind
segments.zh: 所以这些要点都要记住，

segments.text: because of this, we can control the fire hazards
segments.zh: 因为这样我们就能控制火灾危害。

segments.text: Then we saw the hazards
segments.zh: 然后我们看到的危害是

segments.zh: 噪声和振动危害，

segments.text: So now let's know how we can control it
segments.zh: 那现在我们来了解一下怎样控制它。

segments.zh: 朋友们，发电机的发动机

segments.text: vibrates and creates noise
segments.zh: 会振动并产生噪声，

segments.zh: 而大量的噪声和振动

segments.text: the problem of hearing loss can be created

segments.zh: 要尽量远离工作区域

segments.text: far away from the work area
segments.zh: 放到远离工作区域的地方，

segments.zh: 也就是要使用耳塞或耳罩。

segments.text: So all these points you have to keep in mind

segments.zh: 因为通过这些要点，
